provenance.baseline: Hong Kong Observatory Gregorian-Lunar Calendar Conversion Table
provenance.independence: Built only from HKO text tables; does not read LUNAR_YEAR_PACKED or conversion outputs.

note1900.limitation: HKO has no T1900e.txt. Lunar 1900 is boundary sentinel only; public lunar input remains 1901–2099.
note1900.verified: 1901-01-01 → lunar 1900-11-11 verified via HKO T1901e daily rows; months 11–12 lengths derived from month-start spans.
note1900.residual: Lunar 1900 leap-month index cannot be verified from HKO full-year tables; runtime packed value retained for internal conversion only.

provenance.note2100: Lunar 2100 NY is in T2100e; final month may be incomplete at Gregorian 2100-12-31.

packedCorrections.note: months 8/9 lengths swapped (HKO vs classic lunarInfo)
months 3/4 lengths swapped (HKO vs classic lunarInfo)
